test_title: PYST 3: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown (Figures 1 - 3). Find the number on the face opposite to the face having ‘3’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c5ed651b2cd01c2b971c665ce82ade2b913ec1e41c749a85a511e7953d33d85.png]
solution:
When we compare figure 1 and figure 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7895fd134b575c31ba13168427b78e8e4018313bde50f539fe21544f32031367.png] We can see that 5 is opposite to 1.

When we compare figure 1 and figure 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53e0e4d4a26f38c0b4581a2e5ae3079aed69cdf9da03eea1f638b3b9d31f4d59.png] We can see that 4 is opposite to 6.

Now we only have two faces left i.e., 3 and 2 which means 2 and 3 are opposite to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.
